name: Virtue
overview: Scripture reveals virtue as a manifestation of upright living and moral excellence, evident in the trustworthiness of a virtuous woman and the integrity of one who walks rightly. Jesus' ministry demonstrated that virtue is a powerful, healing force flowing from Him, affirming the spiritual strength inherent in godly character. The fruit of the Spirit, including goodness and faith, further underscores virtue as an outgrowth of the Spirit's work in the believer, guiding conduct marked by love, peace, and gentleness.
